How Many Hours I Studied Daily for SI Rank 2: My Timetable

3 min readBeginnerPunjab Police Sub Inspectorstudy timetablestudy routinepunjab police sistudy hours
Quick answer

I studied 8 to 10 hours a day in six 1.5-hour shifts, with gym every evening and 8 hours of sleep. Here is my exact daily timetable for Punjab Police SI.

≈ 3 min to finish · Beginner

The question I get asked most is: "How many hours did you study every day?" The short answer is 8 to 10 hours on average.

But the number alone does not help anyone. What matters is how those hours were spread across the day, and how I kept the routine going for months without burning out. Here is my full day, from waking up to going to sleep.

My daily timetable

TimeWhat I did
9:00 amWake up, get fresh
10:00 – 11:30Shift 1 (study)
11:30 – 12:0030-minute break
12:00 – 1:30Shift 2 (study)
1:30 – 2:301-hour break (lunch, rest)
2:30 – 4:00Shift 3 (study)
4:00 – 4:3030-minute break
4:30 – 6:00Shift 4 (study)
6:00 – 8:00Gym / ground, bath, dinner
8:00 – 9:30Shift 5 (study)
9:30 – 10:0030-minute break
10:00 – 11:30Shift 6 (study)
12:00 – 1:00 amPlan the next day: what to study and how
1:00 am – 9:00 amSleep (a full 8 hours)

That is six shifts of 1.5 hours, about 9 hours a day. On a slow day it was 8 hours; on a good day, 10.

Why this routine worked

  • A fixed place to study. I had a study table and chair in my room. Sitting there at 10 am meant study had started.
  • Short shifts, fixed breaks. Nobody can sit for 10 hours straight. A 1.5-hour shift is long enough to focus and short enough to finish. My blog on the 1.5-hour shift method explains this in detail.
  • Gym in the evening. The day's tiredness and frustration went out at the gym, so the two night shifts started with a fresh mind.
  • No compromise on sleep. Whether I slept at 12 or 1, I got 8 hours. Without full sleep, the next day's 9 hours do not happen.
  • Planning the next day at night. 12 to 1 am was my planning hour. I decided what to study the next day and how to study it. So when I sat down at 10 am, I already knew where to start and wasted no time deciding.

Do you need to study 10 hours too?

Not on day one. If you are just starting, begin with 2 or 3 shifts and add more slowly. Doing 10 hours in week one and quitting in week three is worse than 5 hours a day for months. Hours matter, but studying every single day matters more.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

How many hours a day should I study for Punjab Police SI?

I studied 8 to 10 hours a day, in six shifts of 1.5 hours. If you are just starting, begin with 2 or 3 shifts and add more slowly. Studying every day matters more than the number of hours.

What time should I start studying in the morning?

I woke up at 9 and sat at my study table at 10 every day. A fixed start time and a fixed place tell your mind that study has begun.
